description: MarineCadastre US coastal AIS vessel tracks for seasonal months of 2025 (January, July, December; acquired month by month in that priority order): track-segment and stationary-period events, vessel entities with IMO identifiers and dimensions, and vessel-month activity observations

source.publisher: NOAA Office for Coastal Management, BOEM and USCG (MarineCadastre.gov)
source.license_notes: AIS coverage is limited to US coastal receivers; data are cleaned and segmented by the publisher. Reading GeoParquet requires the optional pyarrow package.

sampling.criteria: Historical AIS availability; no bulk daily download on laptop
sampling.reason: AccessAIS status endpoint returned HTTP200 on2026-09-15. Its export flow requires an asynchronous order; no bounded synchronous track export or bulk archive has been verified within62MiB. No vessel tracks acquired.

acquisition.description: MarineCadastre cleaned AIS vessel-track GeoParquet, one indivisible file per month, in priority order: 2025-01 (1,143,946,313 bytes, winter), 2025-07 (1,781,213,231 bytes, peak summer), 2025-12 (1,395,724,810 bytes, winter / holiday peak); total 4,320,884,354 bytes. Shards are reserved one at a time, so a budget stop publishes the completed months and stays resumable. No further month fits under the 10% per-dataset cap (the smallest remaining 2025 month, February, is 1,081,091,902 bytes).
